Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) time Qual Ptr quality of HW time stamp, e.g. based on current drift time Stamp Ptr current time stamp Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: successful E_ NOT_ OK: failed Description Returns a time value out of the HW registers according to the capability of the HW. Important Note: Eth If_ Get Current Time may b e called within an exclusive area. Available via Eth If.h
